preamble: Lenition of postvocalic /d/ to the palatal glide [j] is attested between Old and Middle Persian, where Old Persian pād- 'foot' became Middle and New Persian pāy. Cases in Romance such as Latin hodie > Spanish hoy involve coalescence of the cluster /dj/ with the yod and belong elsewhere.
sources: Wiktionary contributors. پای (Persian etymology: Middle Persian pāy < Old Persian pād(a)). https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D9%BE%D8%A7%DB%8C
